result_preview.title: Employee Absence Entitlement API
result_preview.shortDescription: REST API for retrieving and administering employee paid time off entitlements, accrual mechanics, and absence policies.
result_preview.description: Provides programmatic access to employee absence entitlements including vacation days, sick time, and special leave categories. Enables applications to calculate entitlement accruals based on organizational policies, retrieve current entitlement positions, and apply entitlement adjustments. Supports integration with absence request workflows and compensation systems to ensure accurate absence accounting and regulatory compliance.
